notes: Single file, no assets: all art is drawn with canvas paths and all audio is synthesised with the Web Audio API. Title screen with an attract-mode lawn, a four-plant loadout picker, a how-to-play screen that lists the build plan, settings, pause, results and a localStorage leaderboard. 5x9 grid, sun economy (sky drops plus sunflowers), six plants (sunflower, peashooter, wall-nut, snow pea, cherry bomb, repeater) with per-seed cost and recharge, five zombie types with breakable armour, flag waves and big waves, one single-use lawn mower per row as the fail state, a shovel, fast-forward, screen shake and particles. Played through in headless Chromium with real DOM and canvas clicks: planting, waves, mower triggers, scoring, saving a score and rendering the leaderboard all work with no console errors.
